validation.scope: Integrated Godot pass and movement-observer race
validation.result: Normal staged gate passed all65 Godot suites, persistence restart and initial network matrices, then exposed a timing race in the old playable-scene movement fixture: host could finish walking before client recorded its origin during cooperative preparation, exhausting readiness and cascading into later assertions. Fixture now prepares before connecting and requires a real client movement-baseline acknowledgement before walking; Start waits for actual ACTIVE within the original deadline. Two consecutive real two-peer/five-rematch reruns pass. Production cold-Start/barrier validation is unchanged and unprewarmed. Remaining network/backend preflight and full staged rerun pending.

validation.result: Dedicated movement origins now sampled after ACTIVE reseating; two real dedicated runs pass five rematches/recovery.
